frozenBefore: delivery implementation and final candidate selection; thresholds were sent before feasibility experiments

reference.normalization: existing canonical RGB8 asset; originally EXIF-transposed and Lanczos-downsampled from the downloaded 1280x850 source; no further resizing in this evaluation

metrics.domain: sRGB encoded RGB8, all three channels, opaque full frame
metrics.mae: mean absolute error over all RGB channels

ssim.implementation: scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter per RGB channel; mean of full-frame SSIM map
ssim.roiPolicy: crop the already computed full-frame SSIM map; never recompute window padding inside a crop

roiCoordinates: normalized continuous image boundaries; floor lower bounds, ceil upper bounds, clamp to image; upper bounds exclusive

representation.family: signed additive anisotropic 2D Gaussian functions plus RGB base

requiredEvidence: reference/result side-by-side and matching crops at native sampling
metrics recomputed from the serialized final asset output
independent JavaScript replay compared against Python
real browser load, edit, full-resolution render and PNG export
failed baseline and optimization history retained
legacy assets and routes remain byte-exact
exclusions: not an unseen-scene generation or class-generalization benchmark
not recovered unseen high-resolution detail when zoomed
not physically correct relighting or a learned dynamic scene
not a formal proof or autonomous L2 program RSI result
not a claim that a finite PSNR/SSIM gate establishes universal photorealism
policy: Candidates cannot edit this contract or lower its thresholds. A failed candidate remains failed. Engineering replay/performance results do not substitute for reference quality.
